sources.title: A 1-Separation Formula for the Graph Kemeny Constant and Braess Edges

locators.supports: For a connected simple graph, K=d^T R d/(4m).
A Braess edge or set is defined by strict increase of Kemeny's constant.

locators.location: PDF page 10, paragraph immediately after Corollary 4.3
locators.supports: The naturally labelled P7 additions {1,3} and {5,7} form a Braess set while neither singleton is Braess.

sources.title: Kemeny's constant and Braess cliques in graphs

locators.supports: Irreducibility suffices, periodic irreducible chains retain a unique stationary distribution, and K is the sum of 1/(1-lambda_j) over nonstationary eigenvalues.
For graph random walks P=D^-1 A and K=d^T R d/(4m).
